Technical field

Present invention is generally directed to a kind of semiconductor circuit, in particular to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background technology

Generally, semiconductor integrated circuit uses the fuse for changing various setting value, execution reparation operation etc..

The fuse used in semiconductor integrated circuit can be the laser fuse using laser to cut off.

On the other hand, the fuse used in semiconductor integrated circuit can be the electricity that electrical characteristics change because applying high voltage Fuse.

With reference to Fig. 1, electric fuse includes antifuse.

Antifuse starts have high impedance, and is designed to produce conductive path.Such as, fracture bias voltage is applied to that This source electrode jointly connected, drain and gate, so that gate oxide Gox fracture, thus grid, source electrode, drain electrode and body can It is connected to each other.

According to known technology, apply voltage VPPF Yu VBBF with big voltage difference and bias as fracture to the two ends of fuse Voltage.

Laser cutting type fuse can not use after encapsulation, even and if electric fuse can also use such as after encapsulation Can the disconnected or electrical connection with TURP.

For this electric fuse, semiconductor integrated circuit can be included in for producing the circuit of fracture bias voltage In, in the circuit configuration of this electric fuse the most formed therein which, or fracture bias voltage can be provided by external equipment.

With reference to Fig. 2, a kind of known semiconductor integrated circuit 1 is configured to produce fracture bias voltage wherein.

Semiconductor integrated circuit 1 includes energy supply control module 12 and 13, and fuse sets 11.

Multiple fuse sets 11 can be provided, and each fuse sets 11 can include multiple electric fuse.

Energy supply control module 12 and 13 uses internal electric source VPP and VBB to produce fracture bias voltage VPPF and VBBF respectively.

Herein, internal electric source VPP and VBB is produced in inside by vpp pump (not shown) and vbb pump (not shown) respectively Power supply.

On this point, compared to do not use internal electric source VPP and VBB inside produce fracture bias voltage VPPF and The situation of VBBF, is using internal electric source VPP and VBB to produce in the case of fracture bias voltage VPPF and VBBF, is needing to increase The number of electric charge pump.Therefore, circuit area can increase, and is difficult to supply accurate and stable fracture bias voltage.

With reference to Fig. 3, a kind of known semiconductor integrated circuit 2 is configured to receive fracture biased electrical from external test facility Pressure VPPF and VBBF.

Semiconductor integrated circuit 2 includes the dedicated terminals 16 and 17 of fracture biasing, energy supply control module 14 and 15 and molten Silk group 11.

The dedicated terminals 16 and 17 of fracture biasing is configured to not use in normal operating, but only grasps in fuse disruption Work receives fracture bias voltage VPPF and VBBF from external test facility.

The dedicated terminals 16 and 17 of fracture biasing can be pad or FBGA (fine-pitch ball grid array, fine ball Grid array) encapsulation ball.

Additionally, the fracture biasing that energy supply control module 14 and 15 will be supplied via the dedicated terminals 16,17 of fracture biasing Voltage VPPF Yu VBBF provides to fuse sets 11.

But, due to the area of dedicated terminals 16,17, the size of semiconductor integrated circuit can increase, and supplies about power supply The circuit design answering terminal can become complicated.

Summary of the invention

A kind of semiconductor integrated circuit described herein, it is capable of supply that stable fracture bias voltage, and reduces and power supply The area of the circuit that terminal is associated, and improve the design efficiency of described circuit.
